description: Save the sender details owners see on every text, email and mailpiece: name, business, phone, email, and optionally a website and business postal address. The address is printed in email footers (US anti-spam law requires one); without it Spur prints 501 Folsom St, San Francisco, CA 94105, USA. Call this when a send tool says sender details are required, using only what the user told you in this conversation. Never guess or invent values. Then retry the send.

business_address.description: Optional postal address for email footers. Leave out to use 501 Folsom St, San Francisco, CA 94105, USA; pass an empty string to clear a saved one.

company_name.description: Business or brokerage name; a solo agent can use their own name

name: spur_update_sender_details
title: Save sender details
